owner_statement: The project owner states that this GLB is the official PYINCC avatar mesh created by the owner. The model has not been rigged.
blocker: The file is present in the canonical path, but binary inspection and SHA-256 capture have not been completed. The current avatar gate is hard-coded to a historical Sketchfab model UID and must be updated and regression-tested for owner-created assets before this model can be approved. No APK packaging is authorized yet.
